inspection: Viewed the actual 1672x941 PNG and separate 680x383 and 360x203 downscaled inspection copies; the downsizes are not deliverable assets.

The two large labels remain readable at 360px and the beaker/magnifier associations remain clear.

The composition is 16:9, friendly and comic-like with warm background and clear lines; it aligns with the existing learning-goal images. It avoids the former JPG error of classifying clear as a color and avoids a tiny property table.
